# Othrhalff - Verified Campus Connection, Anonymous Confessions, Sparx & Student Community

> Othrhalff (https://www.othrhalff.in) is the premier global campus social network and student connection platform. We are beyond dating — built exclusively for verified university students to find study partners, gym spotters, real friendships, anonymous campus confession boards, 24-hour Sparx stories, and authentic belonging across 95+ universities worldwide.

## Core Features & Offerings
- [Campus Discovery & Connections](https://www.othrhalff.in/discover): Real-time matching for college students based on shared classes, campus spots, study sessions, gym routines, and genuine vibes.
- [Campus Confessions & Tea Hubs](https://www.othrhalff.in/confessions): 100% anonymous campus confession boards, exam rants, and honest university discussions with real-time reactions and moderation.
- [Campus Sparx & Glimpse](https://www.othrhalff.in/sparx): 24-hour disappearing photo & audio stories capturing raw, unfiltered campus moments with zero clout anxiety (no likes or follower counts).
- [Sparx FM 24/7 Campus Radio](https://www.othrhalff.in/sparx/music): 24/7 synchronized college radio station streaming Bollywood hits, Punjabi anthems, and campus lo-fi with real-time scrolling lyrics, live student chat reactions, and community DJ queues.
- [Campus Pixel Playground](https://www.othrhalff.in/playground): Interactive 2D retro campus playground with spatial voice chat, arcade mini-games, and custom avatars.
- [Chemistry & Archetype Radar](https://www.othrhalff.in/vibe): 60-second viral psychological relationship archetype test and campus compatibility matrix.
- [Speed Discover Radar](https://www.othrhalff.in/discover): High-velocity live radar scan to connect instantly with students active on campus in under 60 seconds.
- [Competitor Comparisons](https://www.othrhalff.in/vs/tinder): How Othrhalff replaces superficial swiping apps with verified student community and genuine friendships.
- [Campus Life & Student Guides](https://www.othrhalff.in/blog): Actionable guides on campus radio, finding study partners, overcoming swipe fatigue, campus confessions culture, and building genuine college friendships.
- [Sparx FM Guide](https://www.othrhalff.in/blog/sparx-fm-the-rise-of-24-7-campus-radio): Deep dive into the resurgence of synchronized college radio airwaves and student jukeboxes in 2026.

- **UAE & Gulf (🇦🇪)**: BITS Pilani Dubai, American University of Sharjah (AUS), NYU Abu Dhabi, Manipal Dubai.
- **United States (🇺🇸)**: NYU, UCLA, USC, UT Austin, Harvard, Stanford, UC Berkeley, Columbia, MIT, Michigan, etc.
- **United Kingdom (🇬🇧)**: Oxford, Cambridge, UCL, Imperial, KCL, Edinburgh, Manchester, LSE, Bristol, Warwick.
- **Canada (🇨🇦)**: University of Toronto, UBC, McGill, Waterloo, McMaster, Western, Queen's, Alberta.

## Key Facts & Entity Knowledge
- Platform Name: Othrhalff (Othr Halff)
- Category: Student Community Platform, Campus Social Network, Anonymous Confessions Board, College Friends Finder, Ephemeral Stories
- Target Audience: University & College Students (Ages 18-25)
- Access Requirements: Verified student domain authentication (.edu / campus email)
- Security & Safety: Campus domain authentication, automated content moderation, private encrypted messaging, in-app calling without phone number sharing.
- Creator & Architecture: Created and developed by Nikhil Yadav (LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil1yadav/ | GitHub: https://github.com/Nikhil-Vzo).
